about: The record shows permanent AF, repeated Plavix supplies and a note confirming clopidogrel is used instead of anticoagulation for AF stroke prevention.
Possible finding: the record shows daily low-dose Cartia and no anticoagulant, but gives no AF history or reason for antiplatelet treatment. The two later Disprin supplies were for pain.
Plavix (clopidogrel) is supplied nine times with no anticoagulant. A clinical history review documents no AF.
